info.name: OrderFlow API Regression
info.description: Deterministic API checks for authentication, stock, payment idempotency, access control and refunds. No real payment gateway is called.

exec: pm.test('customer login returns a token', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().token).to.have.length(64); });
pm.environment.set('customerToken', pm.response.json().token);

pm.test('catalog has priced, stocked products', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().products.length).to.be.at.least(4); pm.expect(pm.response.json().products[0].priceCents).to.be.above(0); });
pm.environment.set('productId', pm.response.json().products[0].id);
pm.test('insufficient stock is a conflict', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql('INSUFFICIENT_STOCK'); });

pm.test('order total is derived by the server', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(pm.response.json().order.totalCents).to.eql(49800); pm.expect(pm.response.json().order.status).to.eql('PENDING_PAYMENT'); });
pm.environment.set('orderId', pm.response.json().order.id);
pm.test('second customer login succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.environment.set('otherToken', pm.response.json().token);
pm.test('cross-customer read is hidden', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql('NOT_FOUND'); });

pm.test('first capture creates one full payment', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(pm.response.json().order.status).to.eql('PAID'); pm.expect(pm.response.json().order.payments).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(pm.response.json().order.payments[0].amountCents).to.eql(49800); });

pm.test('replay is safe and does not double charge', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().replayed).to.eql(true); pm.expect(pm.response.json().order.payments).to.have.length(1); });
pm.test('different key cannot pay a paid order', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql('INVALID_STATE'); });
pm.test('refund requires admin role', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
pm.test('admin login succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().user.role).to.eql('admin'); });
pm.environment.set('adminToken', pm.response.json().token);
pm.test('over-refund is blocked', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql('REFUND_LIMIT'); });
pm.test('partial refund updates status', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(pm.response.json().order.status).to.eql('PARTIALLY_REFUNDED'); });

pm.test('full cumulative refund closes the order', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(pm.response.json().order.status).to.eql('REFUNDED'); pm.expect(pm.response.json().order.refunds).to.have.length(2); });
pm.test('cancellable order created', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.environment.set('cancelOrderId', pm.response.json().order.id);
pm.test('cancel transitions to CANCELLED', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().order.status).to.eql('CANCELLED'); });
pm.test('cancel cannot execute twice', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql('INVALID_STATE'); });
